title: Op table descriptors
description: OpDesc and ParamDesc: the bench op table as it rides in hello.ops. Wire form produced by OpSpec.describe / ParamSpec.describe on the bench (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:1021-1040, 1175-1188) and read by OpSpec.from_wire / ParamSpec.from_wire on the hub (src/alb/remote/bench_ops.py:60-78, 180-211).

params.description: In argv order. Names are unique within one op.

needs.description: Precondition the bench checks before running: a board in fastboot, a board in EDL (9008), or nothing.

image.description: The op receives an image stream (data frames) after the request.

max_image_bytes.description: Largest image the bench accepts for this op; 0 = bounded only by the bench host's free temp space.

mutates.description: The op changes the device; the hub asks for confirmation and records it.

exclusive.description: The op needs the single job lock. Non-exclusive ops (host reads) may run during a long exclusive job.

timeout_s.description: How long the bench lets the op's tool run before killing it. The hub does not use it; its own ceiling is 1800 s per job (src/alb/remote/flash.py:82).

name.description: Parameter name; also the key of its value in the job request. 'image' is reserved (clients/windows-agent/alb_agent.py:1170-1171).

kind.description: partition: implicit shape rule ^[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}$ that is not carried on the wire (known-gaps G9). enum: one of choices. int: min..max. text: pattern + max_len. argv: list of strings.

default.description: Value used when an optional parameter is missing, null or empty. Any JSON type; for an optional enum it may be a value outside choices (e.g. reboot target "").

pattern.description: Python `re` syntax, applied with full-match semantics (re.fullmatch) on both sides. NOT an ECMA-262 pattern: values in use contain \Z (known-gaps G9).

max_len.description: text: max length of the value; argv: max length of each element.
